context.exploration_scope: Formal closure of the entire PHASE-SSI-S0..S26 Studio Intelligence arc: aggregated all 27 phases into one manifest, re-confirmed both Principles final readiness and unmodified propagation through the trigger chain, re-validated the Trigger->Decision->Principle->Outcome->Experience causal shape, and confirmed no existing data was modified -- no new structure, threshold, policy, or automatic-execution wiring created

problem: A 27-phase arc spanning signal discovery, principle adoption (twice, on two different relationship axes), operational validation, boundary validation, combined readiness, and a repeatedly-exercised change-gated trigger loop had never been certified as a single closed whole -- each phase's own all_clear only proves that phase; closing the arc required an aggregate, mechanical confirmation that every phase completed, the two Principles remained the same records throughout, and the trigger loop's causal shape held everywhere it was ever exercised.

action.action_summary: Aggregated all 27 phases' own verification.all_clear + completion-summary final_state + Experience-capture presence into one manifest without re-deriving any phase's own judgment; re-confirmed S21's PRINCIPLES_OPERATIONALLY_READY and deep-equality-verified the same Principle records propagate unmodified through S22..S26; reused S24's Trigger->Independent->Principle->Outcome shape validator verbatim across S22/S23/S25(gated)/S26 plus an Outcome-presence check; re-confirmed byte-identical Principle/Decision records.

result.note: Every one of 27 phases confirmed complete on its own terms, both Principles confirmed operationally ready and unmodified end-to-end, and the full Trigger->Decision->Principle->Outcome->Experience loop confirmed structurally sound everywhere it was exercised -- Studio Intelligence formally closed, with SELF_IMPROVING_STUDIO_FOUNDATION_READY recorded purely as a readiness label for whatever comes next, not a new phase or policy created by this one.

cause.root_cause_summary: 27 individually-correct phases do not automatically compose into a closed, certifiable arc -- closure is a distinct, aggregate claim that requires its own mechanical audit across all of them at once (every phase's own completion, both Principles' unbroken identity, and the loop's causal shape wherever it ran), precisely because no single phase along the way was ever positioned to check the whole.

lesson: Closing a long, multi-phase arc is itself a judgment that must be earned the same way every phase inside it was: by re-verifying, not re-deriving -- aggregating each phase's own already-recorded completion rather than second-guessing its individual verdict, while still adding the one thing no single phase could have checked (that the whole holds together end-to-end). Recording a next_entry_state as a plain readiness label, with zero new structure or policy attached, is what keeps a closure phase from quietly becoming the automatic-transition mechanism it was explicitly told not to build.
